channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-102490 — Zammad GmbH Zammad
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

item.title: CVE-2026-102489 — Zammad GmbH Zammad
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

item.title: CVE-2026-10520 — Ivanti Sentry
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Sentry (formerly known as MobileIron Sentry) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthenticated user to achieve root-level remote code execution. This vulnerability can be successfully exploited in cases where the Sentry appliance is in an unmanaged state with its endpoints externally reachable. The use of mTLS with EPMM or restricted HTTPS access through Neurons for MDM makes interfaces inaccessible to external actors.

item.title: CVE-2008-4250 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Windows contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Server Service that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted RPC request that triggers an overflow during path canonicalization.

item.title: CVE-2023-21529 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Exchange Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data that allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-1340 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-32432 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-7921 — Hikvision Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Multiple Hikvision products contain an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a malicious user to escalate privileges on the system and gain access to sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-1281 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-24061 — GNU InetUtils
item.description: Threat Signal 82. GNU InetUtils contains an argument injection vulnerability in telnetd that could allow for remote authentication bypass via a "-f root" value for the USER environment variable.

item.title: CVE-2025-24893 — XWiki Platform
item.description: Threat Signal 82. XWiki Platform contains an eval injection vulnerability that could allow any guest to perform arbitrary remote code execution through a request to SolrSearch.

item.title: CVE-2025-59287 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Windows Server Update Service (WSUS) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-24990 — TerraMaster TerraMaster OS
item.description: Threat Signal 82. TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2022-2294 — WebRTC WebRTC
item.description: Threat Signal 82. WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

item.title: CVE-2016-0034 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Silverlight mishandles negative offsets during decoding, which allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2013-0074 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during HTML object rendering, which allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Silverlight application.

item.title: CVE-2017-0213 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Windows COM Aggregate Marshaler allows for privilege escalation when an attacker runs a specially crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2016-7255 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2021-1732 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-23758 — Ajax.NET Professional Ajax.NET Professional
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2026-20253 — Splunk Enterprise
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2026-21643 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-20131 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC)
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary Java code as root on an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2025-11953 — React Native Community CLI
item.description: Threat Signal 81. React Native Community CLI contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated network attackers to send POST requests to the Metro Development Server and run arbitrary executables via a vulnerable endpoint exposed by the server. On Windows, attackers can also execute arbitrary shell commands with fully controlled arguments.

item.title: CVE-2025-2747 — Kentico Xperience CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Kentico Xperience CMS contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an attacker to control administrative objects.

item.title: CVE-2023-24955 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker with Site Owner privileges to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2023-27532 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

item.title: CVE-2022-29499 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 81. The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

item.title: CVE-2021-26085 — Atlassian Confluence Server
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Affected versions of Atlassian Confluence Server allow remote attackers to view restricted resources via a pre-authorization arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /s/ endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2021-22941 — Citrix ShareFile
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Improper Access Control in Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller may allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise the storage zones controller.

item.title: CVE-2009-3960 — Adobe BlazeDS
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Adobe BlazeDS, which is utilized in LifeCycle and Coldfusion, contains a vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2019-0752 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 81. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer

item.title: CVE-2021-21975 — VMware vRealize Operations Manager API
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in vRealize Operations Manager API prior to 8.4 may allow a malicious actor with network access to the vRealize Operations Manager API to perform a SSRF attack to steal administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2019-1458 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 81. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory, aka 'Win32k EoP.

item.title: CVE-2018-13382 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 81. An Improper Authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy under SSL VPN web portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to modify the password.

item.title: CVE-2021-40449 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2021-27104 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to various admin endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2014-1812 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.

item.title: CVE-2020-1472 — Microsoft Netlogon
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of Zerologon.

item.title: CVE-2026-50751 — Check Point Security Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

item.title: CVE-2024-21182 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Oracle WebLogic contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3, IIOP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle WebLogic Server accessible data.

item.title: CVE-2026-21509 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a security feature bypass vulnerability in which reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision in Microsoft Office could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally. Some of the impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2015-7755 — Juniper ScreenOS
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Juniper ScreenOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow unauthorized remote administrative access to the device.

item.title: CVE-2024-54085 — AMI MegaRAC SPx
item.description: Threat Signal 72. AMI MegaRAC SPx contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in the Redfish Host Interface. A successful exploitation of this vulnerability may lead to a loss of confidentiality, integrity, and/or availability.

item.title: CVE-2024-23113 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain a format string vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2022-21445 — Oracle ADF Faces
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Oracle ADF Faces library, included with Oracle JDeveloper Distribution, contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability leading to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-8190 — Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

item.title: CVE-2024-38112 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a spoofing vulnerability that has a high impact to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

item.title: CVE-2024-1086 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Linux kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the netfilter: nf_tables component that allows an attacker to achieve local privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-40655 — D-Link DIR-605 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 72. D-Link DIR-605 routers contain an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain a username and password by forging a post request to the /getcfg.php page.
